Sheriff Sales
Sheriff Sales
Sheriff Sales are processed and conducted by the Civil Section of the Sheriff’s Office. You may contact the Civil Section at 419-774-3570 or at shughes@richlandcountyoh.gov for assistance with Sheriff Sale questions. Civil Sections hours are Monday through Friday from 8:00 am to 4:00 pm.
Bank Foreclosure Sales
To be compliant with Ohio House Bill 390, Bank Foreclosure Sales will no longer be conducted in person; they will only be conducted online. The link provided below will direct you to the official Richland County Sheriff’s Office Online Foreclosure Auction Site. The site is a great resource for information regarding the foreclosure process. Additionally, the site provides training to assist first time users with the auction process. It is highly recommended all first time users access the site and complete the training well in advance of their first auction . Failure to do so may result in your inability to bid during an auction.
https://richland.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov
Tax Foreclosure Sales
Tax Foreclosure Sales, when held, are held on Friday mornings, excluding holidays, starting promptly at 10:00 A.M. in the Richland County Sheriff's Office Training Room, 597 Park Ave E. Mansfield, Ohio 44902 . Legal advertising of upcoming properties to be sold are printed in the Shelby Daily Globe beginning three weeks in advance of the initial sale date. A complete list of withdrawals will be read at the beginning of each respective Sheriff’s Sale. Successful bidders of tax foreclosure properties are required make payment in full at the time of sale.
Property/Sale information listed our website is done as a courtesy and should be verified for accuracy.

Such judgment orders such real property to be sold or otherwise disposed of according to law by the undersigned to satisfy the total amount of such judgment; Public notice is hereby given that the Richland County Sheriff will either dispose of such property according to law or sell such real property at public auction, for cash, to the highest bidder of an amount that equals at least $5,240.87 at 10:00 a.m., at the Richland County Sheriff's Office, 597 Park Avenue East, Mansfield, OH 44905, on Friday the 6th day of November, 2026. If the parcel does not receive a sufficient bid or is not otherwise disposed of according to law, it may be offered for sale, under the same terms and conditions of the first sale and at the same time of day and at the same place on Friday, the 20th day of November, 2026, for an amount that equals the same minimum purchase price as in the first sale.
